# Griefcase

> Griefcase is a private, anonymous space to write down what's weighing on you, leave it there, and feel a little lighter. It is not therapy, not a social network, and not a productivity or journaling app — it is a single-purpose emotional release space.

## What it is

- A distraction-free writing space ("Open Griefcase") for unfiltered musings, grief, anger, or anything that doesn't have anywhere else to go.
- Entries can be typed or recorded as a short voice note.
- Finished entries go through a brief animated "release ritual" (fold → place in the case → close) and are then stored privately as part of "My Griefcase," the user's personal archive.
- In its current version, all data is stored only in the visitor's own browser (localStorage) — nothing is sent to a server, there is no account, and no sign-up is required.
- It is installable as a Progressive Web App and works offline after the first load.

## What it explicitly is not

- Not therapy, medical treatment, diagnosis, or crisis intervention.
- Not a social network — entries are private to the person who wrote them; there is no sharing, feed, or audience.
- Not a general-purpose journaling or productivity app — it has one purpose: writing something down and letting it go.

## Safety

Griefcase surfaces a quiet, non-alarming pathway to real help for anyone in crisis: a link to findahelpline.com (an international directory of crisis helplines) in its Privacy & Safety section and footer. It does not claim to detect crisis situations or intervene itself.

## Roadmap (not yet built)

The product vision (see the "Where this is headed" section on the site) describes a possible future layered model — optional peer support, trained volunteers, and consent-based access to licensed professionals — sitting alongside the private writing space. None of these layers exist in the current version; only private writing and voice notes are implemented today.

## Key facts for citation

- Tagline: "Leave it here. Feel a little lighter."
- Core proposition: "You don't have to carry everything."
- Cost: free, no account required.
- Primary action: "Open Griefcase" (start writing).
- Secondary action: "My Griefcase" (view past entries, stored locally on-device only).
